summary: Verified BUG FIX (homepage renders without error) + backend APIs (content, auth, chat, content persistence) + frontend integrations (chat, admin login). 8/8 pytest tests pass. Homepage shows hero 'Liberdade é estar feliz consigo mesma', no 'Erro:' text, no pageerror. Chat integration works end-to-end via Enter key (POST /api/chat 200, assistant bubble rendered). Admin /admin login rejects wrong password (toast) and accepts 'Amiciadmin2026' → editor-panel + save-btn visible.

minor.issue: Uses $set on top-level fields which fully replaces nested objects (e.g. PUT with {brand:{name:'X'}} wipes brand.tagline). Consider deep-merge or require full document. Non-blocking for current UI which sends full content.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid=chat-send] via Playwright force click did NOT trigger form submit reliably (SVG child intercepts). Pressing Enter in [data-testid=chat-input] works. Real users clicking would work; recommend adding onClick handler on the button OR pointer-events:none on the <Send> SVG so pointer target is the button itself.
React warning: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' logged 4-8x (likely video poster or empty hero image field). Pass null instead of empty string.

action_items: Optional: on the chat send button, add pointer-events-none to the inner <Send/> icon (or attach onClick that calls send) so button clicks reliably submit the form.
Optional: guard img src with `src={url || undefined}` to eliminate empty-string src React warnings.
Optional: consider deep-merge in PUT /api/content to avoid unintended overwrites when partial payloads are sent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/content uses $set on top-level keys → nested objects fully replaced (footgun for partial updates).
server.py logout does not use samesite=none/secure when deleting cookie (mismatch with set_cookie); minor.
chat_sessions dict grows unbounded in memory (no eviction) — acceptable for demo scale.
Site.js has several img elements where src can be an empty string; wrap with `|| undefined` to avoid extra network requests and console warnings.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (homepage render, chat send, admin login wrong+correct)

seed_data_creation: None. Test wrote a transient tagline change and restored it. A previous failed test iteration overwrote brand={name:'X'} — restored to defaults ÂMICI / 'Clínica Âmici · Cirurgia Plástica e Estética' via authenticated PUT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_amici_api.py covers content, auth, chat, persistence. Use press Enter (not force-click) on chat-send in Playwright. Admin login route is /admin, uses password-only field; correct pwd from backend/.env ADMIN_PASSWORD.
rca of the issue: Original reported bug ('site does not appear, error') was addressed by Site.js retry logic (6x, 1.2s apart) around GET /api/content with a branded loading screen. Verified: homepage no longer shows 'Erro:', hero-section renders, no uncaught pageerror. Backend GET /api/content responds 200 consistently.
